files.description: The complete EHI export documentation page. Single static HTML file titled 'Export data format and location' describing the export format (PDF encounter notes + C-CDA XML files), server-side output location, and single-patient export procedure via the admin portal. This is the entirety of the vendor's EHI export documentation.
Full-page screenshot of the EHI export documentation page as rendered in Chrome, showing the Vohra branding, export format description, and export procedure steps.

The redirect notice page at the registered CHPL URL (emr.vohrawoundteam.com). This page informs visitors that the Facility Portal has moved to facilityportal.vohrawoundteam.com and uses JavaScript to construct the redirect URL. Saved to document the redirect chain.
